_comment: Default sim-realism layer for RunEnv(realism=...) (sim/rl/realism.py, docs/SIM_REALISM.ko.md). Every value here is an ASSUMPTION; each block's source names the docs/design/sim2real_params.json entries its values or ranges are compared with; source_todo stays where that file has no verified value. Ranges [lo, hi] are drawn per episode only when the env randomizes; otherwise 'nominal' is used. Scale ranges multiply the nominal value.

source.dr.gear_efficiency: osu_rr_torque_efficiency 0.9-1.0 x (roadrunner@55a092e); 이 범위 0.95-1.0은 더 좁은 가정
source.dr.kt: ndfeb_remanence_temp_coeff -0.1 %/K (partial): ±5 %는 자석 온도 약 ±50 K에 해당하는 가정
source.dr.i_peak: actuator_torque_limit_scale 0.9-1.1 x (yes_repo, run_env)와 비교용; 이 범위는 가정
